args.body: Hi Lena, while running a catalog query today, I discovered an error from the 2026-10-14 price update: 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 through P-1222) were mistakenly included in the 3% price increase. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at these higher prices, resulting in a total overcharge of $4,128.60. I wanted to flag this immediately so we can revert the pricing on these products and coordinate refunds/credits for the affected orders.

I wanted to flag this immediately so we can revert the pricing on these products and coordinate refunds/credits for the affected orders.
